Class ThrowableTypes

java.lang.Object
io.github.jabrena.juno.linker.ThrowableTypes
public final class ThrowableTypes extends Object
The closed-world exception hierarchy: a fixed set of built-in JDK throwables (which Juno models itself, since their class files are never on the classpath) plus any program class whose superclass chain reaches one of them.

Every throwable object starts with a two-word header — its program-wide class id and its message (String address or 0) — so athrow can match catch clauses at runtime and getMessage() is a single load. Only the () and (String) constructors are modeled; exception causes, stack traces and suppression are not.
